```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
iris = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=iris, x='sepal_length', y='sepal_width', hue='species', style='species', palette='deep', s=100)

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Iris Sepal Length vs Sepal Width', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=14)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
